🎬 Land of Bad (2024) – Action Thriller

Kinley, an experienced Air Force drone pilot, provides air support and reconnaissance for a Delta Force special operations team sent on a high-stakes rescue mission deep in the dense, hostile jungles of the Philippines. When the ground team is ambushed by hostile insurgent forces, young Joint Terminal Attack Controller rookie JJ "Kin" Kinney finds himself isolated, hopelessly outgunned, and hunted across enemy territory.

With no immediate military support available and the enemy closing in fast, Kinley becomes Kinney's eyes in the sky, guiding him through brutal terrain and treacherous firefights from thousands of miles away. Bound by an intense virtual brotherhood, Kinley pushes through physical exhaustion, equipment limitations, and command bureaucracy to bring the young soldier home alive.

The film explores themes of brotherhood, duty, modern warfare, survival, and the profound human connection between operators on the ground and air support above. Through Kinney's desperate escape and Kinley's relentless guidance, the narrative exposes the intense pressure and split-second decisions required in life-or-death military operations.

More than a fast-paced military action film, Land of Bad is a gripping look at perseverance and unwavering loyalty under extreme conditions. The journey of its main characters demonstrates that leaving no man behind isn't just a military motto, but a sacred commitment that drives ordinary people to do the extraordinary.

💬 If you were trapped behind enemy lines with only a voice in your ear to guide you, how much trust would you place in a stranger? 👇

source_details.synopsis: Land of Bad is a 2024 American action thriller film directed by William Eubank, who co-wrote the script with David Frigerio. The film stars Liam Hemsworth, Russell Crowe, Luke Hemsworth, Ricky Whittle, and Milo Ventimiglia, and follows a US Army Delta Force team on a rescue operation that comes under attack from terrorists. Land of Bad was released theatrically on February 16, 2024. It grossed $7 million worldwide.
